title: The Archive of Station Meridian
author: Sable Underhill
blurb: Isandro Yarrow, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
